text: The bug is clear: in `spiral`, when the remaining sub-matrix is a single row (`top == bottom`), the "bottom row" pass re-traverses that same row in reverse; and when it's a single column (`left == right`), the "left column" pass re-traverses the middle elements already added by the right-column pass. Fix: guard these two passes.
